{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue (first 10):")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any values contain commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Verify if all non-null revenue values are properly formatted as strings with commas
# For example, if there's a value like '1234.56' without commas, that's a problem
print(f"\nAre all non-null revenue values formatted with commas? {data['revenue'].dropna().str.contains(r'^\d+,\d+\.\d+$', regex=True).all()}")"}
